title: Join a fleet
why: Offer this machine to a fleet you run. Paste one line: the placement controller's address, a space, and the enrollment token the fleet operator minted for this machine (a self-signed controller also needs a further field, sha256:<its certificate fingerprint>, and a machine whose fleet node id is not its hostname needs node=<the id the operator gave you>). The machine is measured first and is refused if it has no podman with quadlet or too little free memory. Joining only reports this machine's capacity: it waits as pending until the operator approves it, and nothing is started here. Skip this if the machine stands alone; join later with `sudo awnix fleet join <controller-url> <token>` and undo it with `sudo awnix fleet leave`.
